original_benchmark.notes: 388 English and 388 Chinese tasks (HF Workspace-Bench @ 3491f9e). Agent versions as pinned in upstream's evaluation/docker/Dockerfile and package files; deepagents runs from the repo's own deepagents/ copy.

harbor_adapter.notes: 53 of the 776 upstream tasks are excluded because no answer built from the task's inputs can pass them (excluded_tasks.json lists each with its reason). Parity cost is the total on the parity key for the agent runs, including sanity checks, superseded runs and diagnostics; the 8 counted runs cost about $66. The judge ran on a Claude subscription token.
